Kasen Ranger 2.0 Electric Bike – Power, Performance, and Versatility

Why Choose the Kasen Ranger 2.0?

For E-Bike riders who demand power, reliability, and versatility, you've come to the right place. The Kasen Ranger 2.0 is a high-performance electric bike designed for adventure seekers, commuters, and outdoor enthusiasts. Whether you're commuting to work, exploring off-road trails, or running errands around town, this eBike is built to handle it all.

Built with a robust 750W BAFANG rear hub motor, this eBike delivers a top speed of 28 MPH and a range of 45-55 miles on a single charge. With its fat tires, hydraulic suspension, and long-range battery, the Ranger 2.0 ensures a smooth and enjoyable ride on any terrain. Whether you're tackling rugged trails or cruising through city streets, the Ranger 2.0 combines power, comfort, and durability to raise your riding experience.

Powerful Motor: 750W sustained BAFANG rear hub motor for effortless climbs and smooth acceleration.

Long-Lasting Battery: Removable 48V 15AH/20AH Samsung Lithium-ion battery with a 4-7 hour charge time.

Fat Tires for All Terrains: Equipped with 4-inch Kenda fat tires and a hydraulic front fork for superior traction and shock absorption on sand, snow, or gravel.

High Payload Capacity: Supports up to 350 lbs, making it ideal for riders of all sizes.

Smart Display: CloudDrive CDC6-PR02 LCD display with USB charging, showing speed, battery life, and pedal assist level.

Dual Braking System: Tektro hydraulic disc brakes (203mm front, 180mm rear) for reliable stopping power in all conditions.

5-Level Pedal Assist: Intelligent pedal assist with a 24-magnet cadence sensor for a seamless riding experience.

Durable Build: 6061 double-butted aluminum alloy frame with internal battery storage for a sleek, weather-resistant design.

Comfortable Design: Ergonomic grips, a Kasen comfort saddle, and an adjustable stem for a customized fit.
